==English== ===Etymology=== From {{inh|en|enm|writen}}, from {{inh|en|ang|wrītan}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*wrītan}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*wrītaną|t=to carve, write}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*wrey-|t=to rip, tear}}. Cognate with {{cog|fy|write|t=to wear by rubbing, rip, tear}}, {{cog|nl|wrijten|t=to argue, quarrel}}, {{cog|gml|wrîten|t=to scratch, draw, write}} (> {{cog|nds|wrieten}}, {{m|nds|rieten|t=to tear, split}}), {{cog|de|reißen|t=to tear, rip}}, {{cog|no|rita|t=to rough-sketch, carve, write}}, {{cog|sv|rita|t=to draw, design, delineate, model}}, {{cog|is|rita|ríta, rita|t=to inscribe, sketch, write}}, {{cog|de|ritzen|t=to carve, scratch}}, {{cog|sla-pro|*ryti|t=to carve, engrave, dig}}, {{cog|pl|ryć|t=to engrave, dig}}, {{cog|cs|rýt|t=to engrave, dig}}. See also {{m|en|rit}} and {{m|en|rat}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{enPR|rīt}}, {{IPA|en|/ɹaɪt/}} ** {{IPA|en|[ɹaɪt]|a=RP}} ** {{IPA|en|/ɹəɪt/|[ɹəɪʔ]|a=US}} *** {{audio|en|en-us-write.ogg|a=US}} ** {{IPA|en|[ɹɑjt]|a=SSB}} *** {{audio|en|En-uk-to write.ogg|a=SSB|text=to write}} ** {{IPA|en|[ɹæ̙ːt]|[ɹæ̙ːʔ]|a=MLE,Jamaica}} ** {{IPA|en|[ɹʌɪt]|a=CA}} ** {{IPA|en|[ɹɑɪt]|a=AU}} ** {{IPA|en|[ɾʌɪt]|~|[ɾəɪt]|a=Scotland}} ** {{IPA|en|[ɾaɪt]|a=Wales}} * {{rhymes|en|aɪt|s=1}} * {{homophones|en|right|rite|wright}} ===Verb=== [[Image:Carl Friedrich Abel cropped.jpg|thumb|right|A [[w:Thomas Gainsborough|painting]] of [[w:Carl Friedrich Abel|a man]] writing.]] {{en-verb|~s|writing|wrote,writ|written,writ,ywriten}} # {{lb|en|ambitransitive}} To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate. #: {{ux|en|The pupil '''wrote''' his name on the paper.}} #: {{ux|en|Your son has been '''writing''' on the wall.}} # {{lb|en|transitive}} To be the author of (a book, article, poem, etc.). #: {{ux|en|My uncle '''writes''' newspaper articles for ''The Herald''.}} #* {{RQ:Besant Ivory Gate|chapter=Prologue|passage=Thus, when he drew up instructions in lawyer language{{nb...}}; his clerks, however, understood him very well. If he had '''written''' a love letter, or a farce, or a ''ballade'', or a story, no one, either clerks, or friends, or compositors, would have understood anything but a word here and a word there.}} #* {{RQ:Hemingway Moveable Feast|page=151|passage=Since I had started to [[break down]] all my writing and get rid of all [[facility]] and try to make instead of describe, writing had been wonderful to do. But it was very difficult, and I did not know how I would ever '''write''' anything as long as a [[novel]]. It often took me a full morning of work to '''write''' a [[paragraph]].}} # {{lb|en|intransitive}} To compose and send written information (to). #: {{ux|en|Please '''write''' to me when you get there.|q=UK}} #: {{ux|en|Please '''write''' me when you get there.|q=US}} #: {{ux|en|He never phones me, but he does '''write''' occasionally.}} #* {{RQ:en:CSL|volume=1|page=2|text=Thinking him somewhat inclined to be angry with her, I '''wrote''' to him in such a way as I thought would not hurt his feelings as a brother, while giving him some good advice as my junior, and remonstrating with him as in the being wrong.}} # {{lb|en|ditransitive}} To compose and send (written information or a written message, e.g. a letter) to. #: {{ux|en|Please '''write''' me a letter. Please '''write''' a letter to me.}} ## {{lb|en|ditransitive|with|[[relative clause]]}} To convey a fact to someone via writing. ##: {{ux|en|Jimmy '''wrote''' me that he needs more money.|q=US}} ##* {{quote-journal|en|journal=Saturday Evening Post|date=11 March 1916|title=[advertisement] Jim Henry, Optimist |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=g54xAQAAMAAJ&pg=GBS.RA10-PA64 |text=Do you know, one man actually '''wrote''' me he thought he could almost shave with the back of the blade, the lather "mellowed" his beard so. }} # {{lb|en|transitive}} To show (information, etc) in written form. #: {{ux|en|The due day of the homework is '''written''' in the syllabus.}} # {{lb|en|intransitive}} To be an author. #: {{ux|en|I '''write''' for a living.}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=1964|author=w:Ernest Hemingway|title=w:A Moveable Feast|page=151 |passage=I said that I did not believe anyone could '''write''' any way except the very best he could '''write''' without destroying his [[talent]].}} # {{lb|en|computing|intransitive|with {{m|en|to}}}} To record data mechanically or electronically. #: {{ux|en|The computer '''writes''' to the disk faster than it [[reads]] from it.}} # {{lb|en|transitive|South Africa|Canada|of an exam, a document, etc.}} To [[fill in]], to [[complete]] using words. #: {{ux|en|I was very anxious to know my score after I '''wrote''' the test.}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=2023|author=[[w:Ayobami Adebayo|Ayọ̀bámi Adébáyọ̀]]|title={{w|A Spell of Good Things}}|publisher=Canongate Books|page=132|passage=Kúnlé had failed biology and chemistry, key requirements for admission into any medical school in the country. Kúnlé’s father wanted him to '''write''' the exams again.}} # To [[impress]] [[durably]]; to [[imprint]]; to [[engrave]]. #: {{ux|en|truth '''written''' on the heart}} #* {{RQ:King James Version|Romans|2|14|15|passage=14 For when the Gentiles which haue not the Law, doe by nature the things contained in the Law: these hauing not the Law, are a Law vnto themselues,
15 Which shew the worke of the Law '''written''' in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witnesse, and their thoughts the meane while accusing, or else excusing one another:}} # To make known by writing; to record; to prove by one's own written testimony; often used reflexively. #* {{RQ:Marlowe Tamburlaine|part=1|scene=iii|page=55|passage=Thoſe walled garriſons will I ſubdue,
And '''write''' my ſelfe great Lord of Affrica:
So from the Eaſt vnto the furtheſt Weſt,
Shall ''Tamburlaine'' extend his puiſant arme.}} #* {{RQ:Milton Eikonoklastes|passage=He who '''writes''' himself Martyr by his own inscription, is like an ill painter, who by writing on a shapeless picture which he hath drawn, is fain to tell passengers what shape it is, which else no man could imagine.}} # {{lb|en|finance}} To [[sell]] (an [[option]] or other [[derivative]]). #
